title: History

entry.firstFiles_one: {{count, number}} file was in your library when Folio started keeping history.
entry.firstFiles_other: {{count, number}} files were in your library when Folio started keeping history.
entry.pruned_one: Thinned out {{count, number}} old Word version
entry.pruned_other: Thinned out {{count, number}} old Word versions

start: That's the start of your history.

empty.title: No history yet
empty.text: Commit your changes and each commit shows up here, newest first.

states.starting: Your first entry shows up here when Folio has saved the first version of your library.

readOnly.title: History is read-only.
readOnly.text: A newer version of Folio changed it. Update Folio to edit messages or restore versions.

damaged.title: Folio can't read this library's history
damaged.text: Your files are fine. Copy the details and send them to the developer.

diff.label: Selected version
diff.empty: Select a file to see this version and what changed

cards.label: Changes in this commit
cards.failed: Couldn't load the rest of the changes.
cards.others_one: and {{count, number}} other file in this commit
cards.others_other: and {{count, number}} other files in this commit

file.currentRestore: This is the version you have now.

none.title: {{name}} has no history yet
none.text: Commit it from Changes to start its history.

restore.title: Restore {{name}} to {{date}}?

where.replace: Folio puts the version from {{when}} back in {{place}}. It shows up in Changes, so you can check it before you commit.
where.recreate: {{name}} isn't in the library anymore. Folio puts the version from {{when}} back in {{place}}. It shows up in Changes, so you can check it before you commit.
where.beside: Another file now has this name, so Folio puts the version from {{when}} beside it as “{{target}}”. It shows up in Changes, so you can check it before you commit.

restore.kept: The version you have now stays in History, so nothing is lost.

recycle.title: This file has changes you haven't committed
recycle.text: Folio moves the file as it is now to the Recycle Bin first, so you can still get those changes back.

reasons.InUse: Another app is using it. Close it there, then try again.
reasons.NotLocal: It isn't downloaded yet. Open it so it downloads, then try again.
reasons.NotRecyclable: Folio couldn't move the current file to the Recycle Bin, so it didn't replace it.
reasons.NotStored: Folio doesn't keep this version any more.
reasons.Pruned: Folio doesn't keep this version any more.
reasons.FileChanged: It was saved again just now, so Folio left it as it is. Check it, then try again.

done.title: Restored {{name}}
done.body: The version from {{date}} is back. Check it in Changes, then commit it.

unchanged.title: Nothing to restore
unchanged.body: {{name}} already has the content of this version.

uncommit.first: The first commit can't be undone.
uncommit.notHead: Only the newest commit can be undone.

undo.doneText_one: Its {{count, number}} change is back in Changes.
undo.doneText_other: Its {{count, number}} changes are back in Changes.

reasons.NotHead: Only the newest commit can be undone. Something changed; the list is refreshed.

editMessage.title: Edit message
editMessage.details_one: {{id}} · {{when}} · {{count, number}} file. You can edit a message until the commit is synced.
editMessage.details_other: {{id}} · {{when}} · {{count, number}} files. You can edit a message until the commit is synced.
editMessage.detailsNoFiles: {{id}} · {{when}}. You can edit a message until the commit is synced.

problems.SummaryTooLong: A summary can be up to {{limit, number}} characters.
problems.SummaryInvalid: A summary can't contain line breaks or control characters.
problems.BodyTooLong: A description can be up to {{limit, number}} characters.
problems.BodyInvalid: A description can't contain control characters other than tabs and line breaks.

reasons.CannotReword: This commit's message can't be changed.
reasons.HistoryReadOnly: A newer version of Folio changed this library.
